description: Write-like shell operations whose target is inside the raw folder, or the folder itself, plus the few scripts Bash must not run. Each pattern is a Python regular expression matched against one pipeline segment; the token RAW expands to raw_target (a path ending in raw or raw/). Every raw rule must carry the RAW token: after a segment that changes into raw/ (cd_into_raw), the following segments are matched with RAW removed, so any write there is denied, and a rule that hardcodes raw/ instead would be unreachable after a cd. A rule with no RAW token (the verify script) matches everywhere. `reason` overrides the default denial message. Read-only commands (cat, rg, grep, head, sed without -i, ls, wc, git status/log) never match. Extend this list rather than the hook code.

deny.name: verify script
deny.reason: running verify.py is blocked: `verified` records that a person read the page against its sources, so only the owner runs the script. Ask the owner to run it themselves, exactly as printed, with `! python3 <plugin>/scripts/verify.py "<page>" --by <id>`.
